parts: For our friends who shared their lives with us...
Feeling a dark shroud upon my soul
and the pain of our parting,
night falls upon my tormented life,
for no trace of your warmth remains.
For now the angels dream at the sight of you
and my sorrowful eyes no longer shine.
A longing for death took the place of pain,
only my loneliness remained when you left.
Night falls upon my tormented soul,
as darkness falls upon the world around me.
Yesterday's love, today blood cast aside.
Yesterday a path, today a road of no return.
They say that sorrow passes
that laughter drowns out tears,
yet I can find no comfort
after having loved you so dearly.
Yolanda
OUR STAR THALEK
This is ours dear Thalek, the "why" of our kennel.
She left us at June 26th, 1997 , marking us deeply in our heart.

I passed an entire day embracing her and crying upon hers body. It cost a great deal to close the injury that remained and to follow ahead. Since then our love by the dogs that compose our family enlarged.
We always have her present and never forget her.
Thalek: You know that everything that we have done has been for you.
The day that you left i made a promise and we are complying with it:
To become some large breeders and lovers of yours.
We already are underway!
THE HEAVENS SHINE BRIGHTER THAN EVER

Today I came to visit you and bring you flowers. But what a cruel visit, knowing that I will never see you again, touch you, stroke you, feel your warm breath and your great slobbery kisses. We will never again play at catching that big, furry bottom of yours. How you loved to run past so we would try to catch it.
You have left me with so many memories that I cannot forget you.

I still cannot think of you without crying, and I don't think I ever will. All I can do is try not to think of you, but I cannot. You are always in my thoughts, and I will never forget you. You were our first Bobtail, our first "great love", the champion of our home... And now you are gone.

The words still will not come. I have so much to tell you. I barely had time to say goodbye. You passed away in my arms. Your last breath was for me. I suppose it was your goodbye, or perhaps a farewell until we meet again?
I only hope that wherever you are, you are happy. That you run and play as you did here. I also ask you to watch over us, to guide us with your light and to care for everyone as only you know how.
BOBBY: WE MISS YOU SO MUCH!!
